response.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), type_averages AS (SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count - o.mean_pair_average) AS avg_margin FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE p.avg_analyst_count > o.mean_pair_average GROUP BY p.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_margin, avg_analyst_count / NULLIF(AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_avg_analyst_count FROM type_averages
